method.unit: accepted match: one Britannica entry and one Wikipedia article
normalisation: long s folded when the s-form has Zipf >= 3.0 and gains >= 2.0
historical spellings mapped by a fixed table
exclusions: words unknown to wordfreq are left out of corpus word counts
words with fewer than 5 uses are left out of the distinctive-word test
method.document_lengths: pair overlap is the share of the entry's vocabulary found in the article, compared with 5 unrelated matched articles
method.distinctive_words: log-odds ratio, informative Dirichlet prior (Monroe et al. 2008)
